purpose: Verify that the focal response-filter estimand remains recoverable when unknown-vantage records are excluded and when demographic reconstruction is restricted to raw ground observations, before real count magnitudes are opened.

calibration_rule.nuisance_calibration: Estimate the shared image offset and collapsed accuracy scales once from the full synthetic 2100-record metadata layout, exactly as in Gate 2E-C.
calibration_rule.sensitivity_process_records: Apply the sensitivity filter only to records used for same-season demographic reconstruction and process fitting.
calibration_rule.reason: The sensitivity tests robustness of demographic reconstruction to observation-source inclusion; it does not redefine the already-frozen global observation calibration.

exclude_unknown.unit_support: retain a predictor-complete process unit only if the filtered metadata retain >=5 distinct seasons, span >=10 years, and observations in both the first and last thirds of 1980-2025

ground_only.unit_support: retain a predictor-complete process unit only if ground records retain >=5 distinct seasons, span >=10 years, and observations in both the first and last thirds of 1980-2025

estimability.rule: A species-mode with >=20 supported predictor-complete units is recovery-testable. Below 20 it is frozen as coverage-limited and is reported as unavailable rather than rescued by broadening the filter.

inherit_from_gate_2e_c: selected forcing scales ADPE=CCAMLR, CHPE=APBP region, GEPE=species-wide

interpretation: Passing means the same frozen focal interaction remains recoverable under the restricted observation reconstruction.
Coverage-limited is not counted as evidence for robustness and must be reported explicitly.
A failed estimable sensitivity does not permit switching the primary observation set; it requires reporting observation-source dependence.
boundary: No real count magnitude is read or modeled.
No predictor, radius, season window, forcing partition or interaction may change.
No direct-only substitution for ground-only is allowed.
Raw vantage is retained only as outcome-blind metadata needed to implement the already-frozen ground-only sensitivity.
